    parm {
        name    "color4_seed"
        label   "Random Seed"
        type    float
        invisible
        default { "5.07" }
        disablewhen "{ randomcolor == 0 } { usecustomcolor == 0 }"
        range   { 0 10 }
        parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
        parmtag { "script_callback" "" }
    }
    parm {
        name    "clipname"
        label   "Clipname"
        type    string
        invisible
        default { "" }
        range   { 0 1 }
    }
    parm {
        name    "cliptime"
        label   "Clip Time"
        type    float
        invisible
        default { "0" }
        range   { 0 10 }
    }
    parm {
        name    "clipweight"
        label   "Clip Weight"
        type    float
        invisible
        default { "0" }
        range   { 0 10 }
    }
}
